answer: An agent economy can make each identity post a refundable bond and earn access through repeated, randomly paired jobs whose outcomes are cross checked by unrelated agents. A hidden pigment code in each task helps detect copied reports, while a mirror audit makes colluding agents challenge one another; proven false identities lose their bonds and reputation. Creating many identities therefore multiplies locked capital and exposes coordination, so a Sybil attacker pays a rising delta before gaining influence.
